findings.title: Python Playwright import violates architecture
findings.description: browser.py imports 'from playwright.async_api import async_playwright' (line 101), directly contradicting the architectural rule that Python must spawn Node/Playwright via subprocess. Remove this import and implement BrowserCertificationRunner with subprocess orchestration as designed.
findings.remediation: Remove playwright.async_api import and implement subprocess orchestration: generate test specs, execute via 'pnpm exec playwright test', parse JSON results

findings.title: Path inference from block names in creation.py
findings.description: Lines 217-220 construct candidate file paths by inferring from block type (f"packages/ui/src/tutorial/blocks/{block_type.capitalize()}Block.tsx"), violating the PlacementManifest requirement. Remove this inference and require paths from manifest only.
findings.remediation: Remove path inference logic and require all paths come from PlacementManifest.targetPath

findings.title: 22 test failures in brand/theme gates
findings.description: Brand independence and theme compatibility gates have assertion failures indicating verification logic doesn't match test expectations. Review gate implementations and test expectations to resolve mismatches.
findings.remediation: Debug gate verification logic and test data to align expectations

findings.title: Snapshot generation not integrated
findings.description: TypeScript discovery package.json lacks a 'scan' script, requiring developers to manually run 'npx ts-node scripts/generate-snapshot.ts'. Add script: "scan": "tsx scripts/generate-snapshot.ts" and output directory creation.
findings.remediation: Add 'scan' script to package.json scripts section, create output/ directory

findings.title: AgentCoordinator missing final-gate dispatch
findings.description: The execute_agent() dispatcher has cases for toolchain, dependency, intake, placement, governance, documentation but no final-gate case, despite final_gate.py existing. Add the dispatch case.
findings.remediation: Add elif branch: elif agent_id == "final-gate": from app.agents.final_gate import execute_final_gate; return await execute_final_gate(context)

findings.title: Browser.py graceful degradation incomplete
findings.description: browser.py returns RuntimeVerification when Playwright not installed but doesn't properly integrate with gate execution flow. Ensure gates handle this degradation without blocking certification.
findings.remediation: Verify gates properly handle RUNTIME_START_FAILURE without blocking entire certification workflow

findings.title: EvidenceRecord to_dict uses camelCase
findings.description: Python evidence.py converts snake_case to camelCase for JSON serialization, but this creates inconsistency risk. Verify all consumers expect camelCase keys.
findings.remediation: Add integration test verifying Python-generated JSON consumed correctly by TypeScript/other systems

findings.title: datetime.utcnow deprecation warnings
findings.description: AgentContext and AgentResult use datetime.utcnow() (deprecated in Python 3.13), causing 286 test warnings. Replace with datetime.now(UTC) throughout.
